title: Learning to Unlearn: Machine Unlearning via Learning the Unlearning Behaviors
abstract: arXiv:2608.16700v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Various machine unlearning techniques have been developed in response to privacy legislation requirements, enabling individuals to exercise their legal right to have their data $D_f$ removed from a machine learning model. This process is typically accomplished via the use of an unlearning function denoted as $U$. Existing methods focus on designing an intricate $U$ to unlearn $D_f \subset D$ from a previous model $A(D)$, so that the unlearned model performs as closely as possible to the retrained model $A(D \setminus D_f)$. However, these methods often suffer from high computational costs when dealing with massive training data, as the complex structures of $U$ become a bottleneck even for models with fewer parameters.   Inspired by Learning to Optimize, we introduce the first learning-based model-agnostic approach, Learning-to-UnLearn (L2UL). Our core insight is to shift from manually designing $U$ to learning the unlearning behaviors

translated_title: 学会遗忘：通过学习遗忘行为实现机器遗忘
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16700v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：为响应隐私立法要求，已开发出多种机器遗忘技术，使个人能够行使合法权利，将其数据 $D_f$ 从机器学习模型中移除。这一过程通常通过使用表示为 $U$ 的遗忘函数来完成。现有方法侧重于设计复杂的 $U$，从先前模型 $A(D)$ 中遗忘 $D_f \subset D$，以使遗忘后的模型尽可能接近重训练模型 $A(D \setminus D_f)$。然而，这些方法在处理大规模训练数据时往往面临高计算成本，因为 $U$ 的复杂结构即使对于参数较少的模型也成为瓶颈。受“学习优化”启发，我们引入了首个基于学习的模型无关方法，即“学习到遗忘”（L2UL）。我们的核心见解是从手动设计 $U$ 转变为学习遗忘行为。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的模型无关机器遗忘方法，通过学习遗忘行为而非手动设计遗忘函数，有效降低了大规模数据处理的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel model-agnostic machine unlearning method that learns unlearning behaviors instead of manually designing unlearning functions, effectively reducing computational costs for large-scale data processing.
